instagram_caption:
Charlie Chaplin's coffin was stolen two months after burial. 🎩

Charlie Chaplin died on Christmas Day 1977 and was buried at Corsier-sur-Vevey, Switzerland. On 2 March 1978 his coffin was taken from the grave.

A caller demanded a ransom, reported as about 600,000 (accounts differ on dollars or Swiss francs). His widow Oona refused to pay. Police tapped the phone and watched 200 phone booths.

In May they arrested two refugee mechanics, one Polish, one Bulgarian. The coffin was found buried in a cornfield near Lake Geneva. The family reburied him under concrete. The leader got four and a half years.

The ransom was never paid. The only thing the crime changed was his grave.
